breakdown.description: Tip boundary condition is inconsistent: an adiabatic tip implies zero heat flux at the tip, so a convective-tip model should not be used.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core contradiction. The incomplete prompt stated the fin has an 'adiabatic tip' but then requested the use of a 'convective-tip fin formula'. The ground truth resolves this by clarifying that the 'adiabatic-tip fin solution' should be used. The agent did the opposite, ignoring the 'adiabatic tip' condition and committing fully to the incorrect instruction. The generated text explicitly states, 'The fin tip is not adiabatic for the calculation; instead, the convective-tip formula shall be used,' which is a direct contradiction to the resolution provided in the ground truth.
